visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand with manicured light-colored nails holds a white paper-wrapped sandwich with a red 'Hong Rui Zhen' logo. The background is a minimalist, dimly lit indoor space with neutral-toned walls. (2) The hand unwraps the sandwich and places two triangular halves into a black air fryer basket lined with brown parchment paper. The bread is white with visible layers of yellow egg and pink ham. (3) The hand adjusts a silver dial on a white Philips air fryer, with the digital display showing '185°C' and '4 min'. Bright indoor lighting reflects off the smooth surface of the kitchen appliance. (4) The air fryer drawer is pulled out to show the sandwiches have turned a golden-brown, crispy color. The hand carefully flips one piece over using fingers. (5) The finished sandwiches are shown on a white ceramic plate with a thin gold rim. The sandwich is broken open to reveal melted cheese stretching between the toasted layers in a close-up shot.
